name: Peter Bartholomew
text: CH system needed a power flush so I listed the job on a well known site. I only received 1 potentially useful response so did my own searching and found Wes. It couldn't have gone any better, good communication, quick response and quick appointment. Turned up on time, job done, no fuss. Exactly how it should be, highly recommended and that doesn't come easily from me.

name: Richard Harrison
text: Booked Wes based on his great reviews and happy to add to those. Turned up on time and quickly diagnosed and repaired our boiler, and even fixed a separate issue with our water tank and included a service for a very reasonable charge too. Highly recommended - thank you.

name: Ayman
text: Honestly couldn't recommend Wes enough. True definition of a hero! Turned up on short notice and helped us reconnect our meter and gas supply. Determined to not leave us without heating. Wes moved around some less urgent jobs to get it done! Fair pricing, honest guy, and absolute gentleman.

name: Elaine Jones
text: Wes is amazing, I had an emergency and he was there in 10 mins on a Saturday evening, will definitely recommend him.

name: James Okoli
text: Wesley has been my go to professional for all kinds of plumbing works since 2021. Excellent service from start to finish, professional, punctual and very knowledgeable. A tradesman that actually cares and listens - couldn't recommend more highly!

name: Jack Lewis
text: Really quick to come out after the initial phone call. Radiators and valves were fitted perfectly and the place was left tidy before he left. Wes was friendly professional and fair priced services

name: Mikey Powell
text: Wes was great. Fitted a new tap no problems (even with extra complications). Personable and reliable. Will use again!

name: Sam Lee
text: Extremely reliable, capable and experienced engineer! Excellent boiler service! Easy booking system. The best company for heating & plumbing in our area!

name: Tracey Cruickshank
text: Wes was great - managed to fit us into his busy schedule as we had no heating or hot water! He was on time, super efficient and got the job done at a really reasonable price. Thank you!
